 St. Louis Cardinals Jordan Walker, Alec Burleson Denied Silver Slugger Awards
 by Doc Holliday Nov 17, 2026, 11:49 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The 2026 Silver Slugger Award winners have just been announced and St. Louis Cardinals finalists Jordan Walker and Alec Burleson were not selected to go home with the trophy.
 The National League Silver Slugger Award finalists for first base in 2026 were:
 Jake Bauers (Milwaukee Brewers) 
 Alec Burleson (St. Louis Cardinals) 
 Rafael Devers (San Francisco Giants) 
 Matt Olson (Atlanta Braves) — winner 
 The National League Silver Slugger Award finalists for the outfield in 2026 were:
 Corbin Carroll (Arizona Diamondbacks) 
 Jackson Chourio (Milwaukee Brewers) - winner 
 Pete Crow-Armstrong (Chicago Cubs) - winner 
 Seiya Suzuki (Chicago Cubs) 
 Fernando Tatis Jr. (San Diego Padres) 
 Jordan Walker (St. Louis Cardinals) 
 James Wood (Washington Nationals) - winner 
 This year’s Louisville Slugger Silver Slugger award winners were just announced in an exclusive broadcast through FanSided .
